description: Original Broderbund Stunts 1.1 EGA/CGA numeric 3D material tables and packed bitmap phases
procedure: Decompress EGA.CMN and MODE.COD with the Stunts RLE/VLE codec; for CGA apply its decompressed DIF to common bytes; concatenate common+COD then decode EXEPACK backward RLE. Offsets address the decoded load image without MZ header.

bitmap_phases.ega: Each !egN byte selects its high nibble for even logical X+Y and its low nibble for odd X+Y. Conversion seeds row phase from stored shape Y.
bitmap_phases.cga: Each !cgN byte is a 2x2 tile: top-left bits7:6, top-right bits5:4, bottom-left bits3:2, bottom-right bits1:0. Conversion seeds row phase from stored shape Y.
cga_evidence_offsets: 0x24210 expands four 2-bit samples into tables at DS:5516/5616/5716/5816
0x27440 tests stored shape Y, then alternates tables0/1 on even rows and2/3 on odd rows
bitmap_phases.cga_raw_draw_evidence: The unconverted runtime bitmap draw routines at0x25762/0x25786 derive Y phase from shape[+0xA] stored Y and X phase from actual draw X at[BP-2]. Ordinary file assets are converted earlier by0x27338, so preserve their baked source phase instead.
bitmap_phases.loaded_file_phase: Normal EGA/CGA file_load_shape2d converts VGA resources to native pixels before raw drawing or RLE parsing. Conversion starts source X at zero and uses stored shape Y. Preserve the baked phase on relocation: phaseX=destinationX-drawX; phaseY=destinationY-drawY+storedShapeY. Stored shape X does not seed conversion. The alternate loader is an exception described below.
loaded_file_evidence_offsets: CGA PVS loader0x2c20d calls0x2c2c7 then helper0x2c4b2, which loads !cg0 and invokes entire-resource converter0x27338 before generic parse_shape2d
EGA PVS loader0x2f6d3 calls helper0x2f75c, which loads !eg0 and invokes entire-resource converter0x2a0b0 before generic parse_shape2d
asmorig/seg035.asm file_load_shape2d_res invokes file_load_shape2d before parse_shape2d
bitmap_phases.alternate_file_phase: file_load_shape2d_nofatal2 bypasses native resource conversion. Alternate resources therefore convert at draw time, using destination X and stored shape Y. These include opponent portraits and sdgame2 effects. Register the load family independently of raw/RLE format.
alternate_file_evidence_offsets: CGA alternate entry0x2c690/0x2c6a2: PVS path0x2c771..0x2c7c7 decompresses/unflips, then returns at0x2c72d without the normal0x2c4b2 conversion helper
EGA alternate entry0x2f8ba/0x2f8cc: PVS path0x2f99b decompresses,0x2f9db unflips, then0x2f9f1 returns at0x2f957 without the normal0x2f75c conversion helper

cga_material_phase: Each packed16-bit material repeats a4x2 tile. Even Y uses the high byte; odd Y uses the low byte. Each byte contains four2-bit pixels, most significant first. Rectangle fill0x23cc5 swaps AL/AH on even Y before storing AL, then alternates bytes by row.

cga_palette.evidence: CGA driver decoded image0x241fa sets BIOS mode4;0x24200 selects AH0B/BH1/BL1 palette1;0x24208 selects AH0B/BX0 black background and low intensity.

cga_mask_phase: Masked polygons retain one bit of coverage per logical pixel. The driver expands each mask byte through DS:3a56 by duplicating every bit. Original CGA uses the mask LOW byte on EVEN Y and HIGH byte on ODD Y; the shared VGA raster therefore needs the original CGA mask byte-swapped. Original function0x25a59 was executed in a16-bit x86 emulator to verify this.
cga_line_phase: preRender_line at0x1fdde stores a16-bit color, but the line raster at0x2392a reads only its LOW byte. That byte repeats four MSB-first2-bit pixels horizontally, independent of Y. The original function was tested at Y0 and Y1 with colors0x1889,0xc00c,0x5566.
cga_point_phase: Actual queued POINT dispatch asmorig/seg006.asm _fill_pixel passes the full material word to putpixel_single_maybe. Original preRender_sphere0x234e8 with half-height zero also passes the full word at0x23515. Original putpixel0x26ab6 reads the LOW byte and shifts it left without masking to2bits; it clears only the target2-bit pixel and ORs the shifted byte into the existing packed4-pixel byte. This can alter up to three preceding pixels within the same byte. Formula: outByte=(oldByte & ~(3 << shift)) | ((colorLow << shift)&255), shift=6-2*(x&3). Original point and size1 sphere were executed independently with identical output atX0..3,Y0..1.
ega_two_color_phase: Original preRender0x1f3da stores the pattern at DS:4bae and alternate color at DS:4bb0, then chooses span raster0x23caf. That raster uses the mask HIGH byte on EVEN Y and LOW byte on ODD Y, fills the base color, and overlays the alternate color where mask bits are set. Therefore the shared call preRender_two_color(pattern,secondary,primary) preserves the original material roles without a mask byte swap.
